name: @elad12390/red-alert-mcp
description: MCP server for the Israeli Red Alert system (Pikud ha-oref / Home Front Command). Real-time rocket and missile alert monitoring for Israel. Query active alerts, check by city or region, get alert history, and receive notifications for ongoing security events. Triggers: red alert, tzeva adom, Israeli alerts, pikud haoref, rocket alerts Israel, missile alert, Israel security alerts, civil defense alerts.
